purpose: Teach: 伊丹/長岡/武藤/菊池/亀田/五十嵐/塚本/八田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、伊丹氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you started a joint venture with Itami.
lines.style: Measured, respectful inquiry. Patient opening. Slight pause before the name, allowing weight to the memory. Seeking affirmation, not information.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは長岡先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was mentored by Naooka-senpai through that time.
lines.style: Formal but warm acknowledgment. Clear enunciation on the name. Steady, deliberate pacing. Voice carries the weight of remembered influence and gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、武藤氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you planned the overseas expansion with Muto.
lines.style: Gentle nostalgia in the opening. Softer tone than before, reaching back into memory. Slight elongation on the final syllables, as if settling into the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは菊池氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father made Kikuchi the cornerstone of our public affairs.
lines.style: Reflective, deliberate. Quiet authority on 'cornerstone.' Pause before the name to honour the decision. Grounded, thoughtful pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、亀田氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you built the accounting structure with Kameda.
lines.style: Same gentle reach into memory as line 3. Voice softens slightly. A rhythm of reverence settling in. Tender attention to each name as it arrives.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは五十嵐氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father nurtured Igarashi as a department head.
lines.style: Steady, measured reflection. Slight warmth on 'nurtured'—pride in the growth of people, not just systems. Clear voice, unhurried. Respect for the mentorship itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、塚本氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father — when you were young, you established the overseas corporation with Tsukamoto.
lines.style: The third iteration of the question pattern. Voice settles deeper into the rhythm of remembrance. Softer attack, patient pacing. A man touching the shape of his father's legacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは八田氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted the entire legal affairs to Hatta.
lines.style: Final response, carrying closure. Measured, formal. Slight emphasis on 'entrusted'—the gravity of delegation. Voice steady and composed, honouring both father and successor.
